text:
Aria T.: hey team, quick obs questions on my first day: 
1) Grafana dashboards I open only show $cluster=prod in the template var drop-down. I need dev and staging options. is that a perms thing or a dashboard config?
2) when i create a new alert in Grafana/Datadog it routes to platform oncall by default. how do i route to my team's oncall (or PD service) instead?
3) Datadog agent local run shows metrics but traces not showing up in the dev dashboard panels. any common tag or sampling misses?
4) who grants edit rights to a single panel so i can tweak thresholds for our feature flag metric?

/devex-bot: Welcome Aria! Please follow the observability onboarding guide: https://go.redwood/onboard-observability and file an access/edit request at https://go.redwood/obs-access-request. DevEx will triage during business hours.

Jules (DevEx): welcome Aria! answers quick: 1) Grafana template vars are populated by the datasource query + folder-level permissions. if you only see prod it's likely the dashboard queries the `org_tags` index and your SSO groups restrict namespaces. i'll add you to the `team:feature-ux` SSO group and share the folder; after that logout/login to refresh.

Jules (DevEx): 2) alert routing: we route by resource tags. add `team:feature-ux` or `pagerduty:feature-ux` to the monitor/alert rule. Datadog monitors have a "Notify the following" field where you can reference a PagerDuty service or a tag-based routing. if you want Platform to keep default but route these, set `tags: [team:feature-ux]` on the monitor and the platform routing policy will pick it up.

Maya (Observability): for traces not showing: confirm you set DD_ENV=dev and DD_SERVICE correctly, and that the tracer sample rate isn't 0. also check `span.service` in the UI and the dashboard panel's query filter. common fix: restart the agent after setting tags or export them in the process env: 
```bash
export DD_API_KEY=...
export DD_ENV=dev
export DD_SERVICE=feature-api
# optional low-rate sampling for dev
export DD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.05
sudo systemctl restart datadog-agent || docker restart datadog-agent
```
If traces still missing, try a small curl to hit an instrumented endpoint and then `trace-analytics` view. i can look if you paste a sample trace id.

Ravi (Platform): adding on alert routing: for PagerDuty we map Datadog tags to PD services via our integration rules. to test routing, create a monitor with `tags:team:feature-ux` and use the test notify flow. if you need a new PD service, open a ticket to #ops-pagerduty (or ping me) and include the team name and escalation policy.

Aria T.: thx. i tried adding DD_ENV and DD_SERVICE but the panels still show 0 for traces. metrics appear though. i also logged out/in on Grafana and still only see prod var.

Jules (DevEx): i just pushed the SSO group add for you; try incognito sign-in (sometimes the SSO token caches). for Grafana template vars: open dashboard -> gear -> variables and check the query used. if it's `label_values(cluster)` we need your user to have permission to list clusters. if not, DM me screenshot and i'll patch the dashboard or add the var.

Maya (Observability): one more thing re: traces: if your app uses autodistro ddtrace, ensure the tracer is initialised before webserver fork (common node/python gotcha). also confirm the agent's trace receiver is enabled in datadog.yaml (`apm_config.enabled: true`).

Aria T.: where do i request panel edit? i don't want blanket edit rights, just one panel on `feature-release` dashboard.

Jules (DevEx): file the small edit request form at https://go.redwood/obs-edit-request with dashboard UID and panel id, or DM me the UID and i'll grant edit on that single dashboard (we use Grafana teams mapping). include what change you want (threshold tweak) and a link to the panel.

Ravi (Platform): FYI for CI agents that push metrics/traces during tests, prefer using a sandbox org named `redwood-sandbox` — telemetry there doesn't affect prod billing. reach out if you need a sandbox API key.

Aria T.: got it. i filed the edit request form and uploaded a screenshot of the variable setup. also ran the trace test after restarting agent and still no traces, i'll paste trace id in DM.

Maya (Observability): saw the form, i granted view+edit on that panel for your user id and added `team:feature-ux` tag mapping for alert routing. try the monitor test and LMK.

Aria T.: can see edit now and changed the threshold locally (duplicated panel). monitor test routed to our PD service successfully :tada: traces still TBD, will DM trace id. thanks so much for speed!

Jules (DevEx): awesome — welcome again and ping us any time. closing this thread unless you have more. :wave:
